 Jaden McDaniels scored 14 points in win Sunday 
 by Leo Sells | Timberwolves Correspondent | Mon, Oct 26th 2026, 10:51am EDT 
 Jaden McDaniels scored 14 points (6-10 FG, 1-3 3PT, 1-1 FT) to go with six rebounds and three blocks in Sunday's 117-94 win over the Toronto Raptors. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 The Timberwolves were able to pick up another comfortable win over the Raptors on Sunday. McDaniels was a key contributor in that, scoring 14 points on good efficiency over the course of 31 minutes of action. Fantasy managers should expect him to continue to be reliable moving forward.
